citation.title: Guidance Scheme for Glide Range Maximization of a Hypersonic Vehicle
citation.publication: AIAA Guidance, Navigation, and Control Conference

source_access.effect: The citation and research claim are attributable; Eq17, Eq18 and aerodynamic curve fidelity to the paper are not claimed by this bundle.

formula_authority.accepted_scope: Fixture-local scientific qualification of the archived Legacy transcription using independent analytic and high-precision implementations.
formula_authority.legacy_test_limitation: The Legacy tests repeat the production algebra and therefore are behavioral checks rather than an independent scientific oracle.

assumptions.statement: Inputs use SI units; altitude is positive away from the reference sphere, speed and gravity magnitude are positive, and rho_h is the density derivative with respect to altitude.
The local spherical radius is r = reference_radius + altitude and remains strictly positive.
The formulas use CLv_star = CL_star * cos(bank); the accepted domain requires CLv_star to be strictly positive.
The analytic envelope uses CL = CL0 + CLalpha*alpha and CD = CD0(M) + K*CL^2 with positive CD0, K and CLalpha; the unconstrained positive-lift optimum must lie inside the declared alpha interval.
Density is exponential for the derivative fixture, speed of sound is locally linear in altitude, and dCL_star/dMach is the analytic derivative of the fixture-local parabolic optimum.
Eq17 and Eq18 are separate immutable strategies. A derivative degeneration, invalid domain or singular B denominator returns a structured failure and never selects another equation.
TDCT computes error = gamma_reference - gamma_measured, alpha_raw = alpha_star + gain*error and alpha_command = clamp(alpha_raw, alpha_min, alpha_max), with a finite nonnegative gain.

excluded_claims: digitized aerodynamic curve fidelity or licensing
closed-loop stability, range optimality or heating-rate performance
production guidance, loader, compiler, kernel or session behavior
